params._newState: Proposed new state (ACTIVE, DEGRADING, or BREACHED)

params._toNonBreachingParty: If true, escrow goes to non-breaching party

acceptNegotiation(bytes32).notice: Counterparty accepts to negotiate. Moves treaty to NEGOTIATING.

acceptRenegotiation(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Accept renegotiated terms. Moves back to ACTIVE.

activateTreaty(bytes32).notice: Called after constitutional checks pass on both sides.         Activates the treaty. Moves to ACTIVE.

executeSettlement(bytes32).notice: Execute settlement payout. Called by monitor agent after         escrow conditions are verified.

finalizeNegotiation(bytes32).notice: Finalize negotiation. Both parties must call this or one party         calls with a signature from the other. Moves to VALIDATING.

getAmendmentChain(bytes32).notice: Get amendment chain for a treaty.

getAttestationChain(bytes32).notice: Get attestation chain for a treaty.

getTreatyHealth(bytes32).notice: Compute treaty health score (0-100) based on conditions.

getTreatyState(bytes32).notice: Get full treaty state for frontend display.

proposeTreaty(address,(bytes32,bytes32,u.notice: Agent proposes a treaty to a counterparty.

recordAttestation(bytes32,uint256,bytes3.notice: Monitor agent records an attestation for this cycle.         Evaluates conditions and transitions state if needed.

renewTreaty(bytes32,(bytes32,bytes32,uin.notice: Renew a settled treaty with new terms and duration.

resolveBreach(bytes32,uint256,bool,uint2.notice: Mediator Swarm submits resolution for a breach.

terminateTreaty(bytes32,string).notice: Terminate a treaty (mutual agreement or expiry).

updateNegotiationTerms(bytes32,(bytes32,.notice: Either party updates terms during negotiation. Records round.
